description: Frontmatter, section structure, section word caps and token budget for a feature document in docs/feat/. The prose authority is docs/__meta__/feat.md: section 2 for the frontmatter, section 4 for the structure, section 6 for the caps and the budget. It is the base layer: a namespace layer, feat-<namespace>.structure.json, is applied on its own beside it and can only add to it. Summary opens every document, then Table of Contents and Key Concepts when present; sections a document adds go directly after those or after Limitations; References then Code References close it. Usage and Code References are optional here for every type; which type requires or forbids them is checked by review. Fenced code blocks and table rows cost no words.

outline.description: Two to four sentences expanding on the frontmatter description: what the feature does, why it exists and its primary use.
examples: `datafusion-functions-jsonschema` adds JSON Schema validation to DataFusion SQL.

outline.description: Links to the sections below it, one numbered entry per section, starting at Key Concepts.
The terms the document uses, defined once, in one line each.
How the feature fits together, when usage does not show it.
examples: A literal schema is compiled once at planning; a schema column is compiled per distinct schema.

outline.description: Options, their defaults and where they are read from, usually as a table.
examples:
| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `max_errors` | `100` | Errors listed per row |

outline.description: How to invoke the feature, with working examples in fenced blocks. Required for a feature document, forbidden for a meta document.
The feature's known constraints, as a short list.
examples: - No `$ref` is fetched from the network or the filesystem.

outline.description: Cross-references, one per line with the relationship named first, linking up to the base and never down to an extension.
The source files behind the feature, one entry per line and never wrapped. Required for a component document, forbidden for a meta document.
